An '''artillery battery''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
It was comprised of four [[artillery line]]s, and totalled one hundred and fifty-two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], twenty-three support personnel, and seventy [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Depending on the configuration of the individual artillery lines, the battery could field either sixteen heavy or medium artillery tubes, or thirty-two light artillery pieces.<ref name="ISB" />

Artillery batteries could be augmented by two [[assault platoon]]s and two additional [[artillery line]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
